scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting, Closing

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 2 occurrences of >30s dead air (max gap 36s).

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment
scorecard.coaching: The agent should acknowledge the customer's frustration and show understanding of their situation, e.g., 'I apologize for the inconvenience this is causing' or 'I can imagine how frustrating this must be for you'.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Verify the customer's account information and confirm it matches the company's records to ensure accurate troubleshooting and resolution.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: To improve paraphrasing, the agent should rephrase the customer's concerns and questions in their own words, ensuring understanding and clarity, e.g., 'Just to confirm, you're saying your internet has been slow all morning and you've already rebooted the router?'

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask more diagnostic questions to probe the problem, such as 'Can you describe the issue in more detail?' or 'Have you noticed any specific error messages?' to better understand the root cause of the issue.

scorecard.name: Set proper expectations
scorecard.coaching: Set clear expectations for the customer regarding the resolution time and any subsequent actions, e.g., 'I'll check on the outage and get back to you within the next 10 minutes'.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Take ownership of the issue by acknowledging the customer's frustration and expressing a commitment to resolving the problem, rather than simply stating 'it's probably something with your setup'.

result.summary: Customer reports slow internet, agent suggests rebooting and waiting
